description: Create a subscription topic, or rename an existing one by its key: a kind of marketing mail people can opt out of on its own (product updates, promotions) while staying on the rest. Another provider's groups or interests that subscribers chose for themselves become topics; a label they never chose is a tag, not a topic. default_subscribed decides who gets the topic's mail before they choose, and changing it on an existing topic moves everyone who never chose.

default_subscribed.description: Defaults to true when the topic is created

key.description: Lower-case letters, digits and hyphens, e.g. "product-updates"

name: save_topic
